text: 证监会核准山东省财欣投资有限公司成为德邦证券主要股东，对财欣投资依法受让德邦证券420,681,000股股份（占公司股份总数10%）无异议。
text_en: The CSRC approved Shandong Caixin Investment Co., Ltd. as a major shareholder of Debon Securities, and had no objection to Caixin Investment's lawful transfer of 420,681,000 shares of Debon Securities (accounting for 10% of the company's total shares).
